Thus , ( 1 house ) = ( combined rate ) x ( 3 hr ) and the combined rate = 1 / 3 . To find a combined rate , we add individual rates . ( combined rate ) = ( Mary ’ s rate ) + ( Lisa ’ s rate ) 1 / 3 = 1 / 4 + ( Lisa ’ s rate ) ( Lisa ’ s rate ) = 1 / 3 - 1 / 4 = 1 / 3 * 4 / 4 - 1 / 4 * 3 / 3 = 4 / 12 - 3 / 12 = 1 / 12 Lisa ’ s rate is 1 / 12 of a house every hour , or in other words , 1 house in 12 hrs . Thus , it would take her 12 hours to paint a house of the same size . Answer : D .
